title: A West Texas family wanted its ranchland to become part of Big Bend National Park; a US House panel has advanced a bill allowing about 6,100 acres to be added through voluntary donation or exchange
summary_full: The Congress is exploring the Big Bend National Park Boundary Adjustment Act, which proposes to extend the park by incorporating 6,100 acres from the Fulcher family's ranch. The Big Bend Conservancy plans to acquire this land to enhance conservation efforts and safeguard its ecological importance. This boundary expansion aims to protect vital habitats and historical landmarks, emphasizing the value of preserving lands with rich familial and historical narratives.
